summary: @servicetitan/marketing-ui preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: Version 9.3.2 of @servicetitan/marketing-ui ships an obfuscated preinstall pipeline that fires automatically on `npm install`. package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs is obfuscated with hex-mangled identifiers (e.g. `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and indirection wrapper dictionaries (`_0x19328d.YCZJE(...)`) that hide plain calls to network and process APIs. At install time it downloads the Bun runtime binary from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bun, ['math_init.js'], {cwd: D})` to run a sibling file. `math_init.js` is a 720KB Bun-compiled bundle whose header is `// @bun @bun-cjs`, followed by string-array rotation (`WV8StW`) over a large mixed dictionary and a 78-character-alphabet decoder (`hc1jfK9`), preventing inspection of its behavior. The package's declared purpose is a React marketing UI component library, which does not require a second language runtime or an opaque compiled payload at install time. Executing this preinstall hook runs attacker-chosen code on the installer's machine outside Node's normal resolution, evading scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
